messages:
customer_alex: hey team - we have multiple users getting 400 from /v1/tools/invoke. error body says schema validation failed: missing required property 'mode' AND additionalProperties rejected 'sessionType'. customers blocked and it's affecting a paid workspace. request_id=req_abc123 time=2026-02-12T15:04:22Z

support_engineer_amy: thanks for the ping — can you paste the exact request payload and the API error JSON (no creds) + client sdk version? also which region/tenant?

customer_alex: payload and error below (redacted):

Error response:
```
{
  "error": "ValidationError",
  "message": "schema validation failed",
  "details": {
    "errors": [
      {"keyword":"required","params":{"missingProperty":"mode"},"instancePath":"/args"},
      {"keyword":"additionalProperties","params":{"additionalProperty":"sessionType"},"instancePath":"/args"}
    ]
  },
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "status": 400
}
```

Request payload we sent:
```
{
  "tool": "pdf-extract",
  "args": {
    "file_url": "https://s3.company-bucket/abcd.pdf",
    "sessionType": "interactive",
    "pages": [1,2]
  }
}
```

Client: company-sdk v2.4.1 (JS), region: us-west-2

support_engineer_amy: hmmm — looks like the canonical tool schema expects args.mode (string: 'sync' | 'async'). two problems: 1) 'mode' is required so omitting it triggers the required error; 2) schema has additionalProperties=false so any unknown key (sessionType) is rejected. both show up in the same validation run.

support_engineer_amy: quick question: did this start after an SDK upgrade or did customer recently switch SDK?

customer_alex: they started seeing it after our weekly deploy (we pinned company-sdk 2.4.1 ~2026-02-10). no deliberate changes to how we call tools. some traffic still succeeds (older clients?) but about 30% of invocations fail.

eng_mohit: @support_engineer_amy tagging in. earliest suspicion: there was a server-side schema tightening change in the runtime on 2026-02-11 that set additionalProperties=false on many tool schemas. it was intended to catch bad args but broke clients relying on permissive behavior. i can reproduce locally with the payload above.

eng_mohit: repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/tools/invoke \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"tool":"pdf-extract","args":{"file_url":"https://s3.company-bucket/abcd.pdf","sessionType":"interactive"}}'
```

eng_mohit: validator output: 
```
ValidationError: required property 'mode' missing at /args
ValidationError: additional property 'sessionType' not allowed at /args
```

sre_lana: also seeing a small gateway latency spike (p95 increased ~120ms) in the same window — could be retries from clients seeing validation errors. investigating routing and retry loops.

support_engineer_amy: customer is asking for ETA and workaround. recommended interim options: 1) update client to send mode (sync|async) — may be nontrivial for them; 2) server-side compatibility: accept 'sessionType' as alias for 'mode' OR temporarily set additionalProperties=true for tool schemas until we ship a compatibility fix. which is cheaper?

eng_mohit: cheaper: add an alias mapping in the request preprocessor that maps sessionType -> mode when present, and keep validator strict. i'll open a hotfix PR to the runtime that performs this mapping for a small subset of affected tools (pdf-extract, image-ocr). fallback: flip additionalProperties on, but that is riskier.

support_engineer_amy: please treat as customer-facing regression. i've created support ticket SUP-4982 and notified the account manager. cc @pm_paul

pm_paul: thanks — this looks like a regression. we need a visible ETA and a canary plan. please include a note in the customer ticket about which workspace ids were impacted and the mitigation steps.

eng_mohit: plan: push compatibility mapping to staging in ~2.5h, run canary for 1h, then staged rollout to prod taking ~8h total. will include telemetry to count how many requests had sessionType present so we can deprecate later.

support_engineer_amy: can you paste the PR link when ready and add steps we can give customer for immediate workaround?

eng_mohit: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/r/runtime/merge_requests/1456 (WIP) — will add a runtime flag 'compat.session_type' and default it ON for hosted for 72h. Dedicated/private customers can apply shim in gateway config.

support_bot: deploy-bot: feature flag 'compat.session_type' enabled in staging for runtime-svc-1 at 2026-02-12T17:30:00Z (canary).

customer_alex: appreciated. please confirm when prod change goes out. this is blocking a paying customer workflow.

support_engineer_amy: noted — will update SUP-4982 and ping when prod canary starts.

eng_mohit: ETA prod canary start ~2026-02-12T23:00Z, full prod ~2026-02-13T03:00Z if canary stable. i'll post logs and request counts once we have numbers.

support_engineer_amy: thanks everyone. assigning follow-ups:
- eng_mohit: runtime mapping PR + rollout plan
- sre_lana: verify gateway retry behavior and ensure no retry storm
- pm_paul: coordinate account comms
- customer_alex: if you can capture a failing request_id for one more example that would help traces

customer_alex: will send one more request_id in a bit. thanks for fast response. :thumbsup:
